records.name: Molten Burst
records.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

description.value: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

tooltip.value: Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing {{ damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_damage }} Max health magic damage and Slowing by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds . It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus. Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals {{ calc_dragon_damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_dragon_damage }} Max Health magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow_dragon }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds . The fireball leaves behind a trail for {{ groundlingerduration }} seconds that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second . {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Emberstrike
records.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

tooltip.value: Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal {{ calc_max_health_damage }} max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds. Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing {{ calc_damage }} physical damage . records.name: Dragon's Descent
records.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

description.value: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

tooltip.value: Passive : Shyvana generates {{ fury_generation }} Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by {{ tt_fury_mult }} while in Dragon Form , and reduced {{ tt_fury_aoe_penalty }} by when striking in an area against non-champions. Active : Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form , becoming Unstoppable , and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and causing them Flee for {{ fearduration }} seconds . While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains {{ calc_bonus_health }} bonus Health , size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Inferno Aegis
records.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage . Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for {{ calc_base_heal }} + {{ calc_missing_health_heal }} Missing Health .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

lore.value: Shyvana is a fearsome half-dragon warrior. Though she often appears humanoid, she also rules the skies as a dragon, incinerating her foes with fiery breath. Having saved the life of the crown prince Jarvan IV, Shyvana now serves uneasily in his royal guard, struggling to find acceptance among the suspicious people of Demacia.
